description: Carry-over and negative amounts (see main.zhang), the pages before a budget's first month, within its months and after the last generated month, the queries of a year, an unknown budget, malformed parameters, and the retired budget endpoints (#754).

request.bql: SELECT name, date, currency, alias, category, accounts, close, close_time FROM #budget_definitions
SELECT name, date, time, timestamp, type, amount FROM #budget_events
SELECT name, date, year, month, currency, alias, category, assigned, added, activity, available, closed, accounts FROM #budgets
SELECT date, time, account, narration, units(position) AS units, budgets FROM #postings
SELECT name, sum(added) AS added, sum(activity) AS spent, last(available) AS left FROM #budgets WHERE year = 2024 GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE number(available) < 0 ORDER BY name, date
SELECT name, assigned - added AS carried_over, added, assigned FROM #budgets WHERE date = 2024-03-01
SELECT name, date, assigned, activity, available FROM #budgets WHERE date >= 2024-02-01 AND date <= 2024-04-01 ORDER BY date DESC, name

request.note: KNOWN-ISSUE: a `month` that is not the first day of a month is taken, not refused: budgets.month and budgets.budget_month answer the month carried over (its available amount as assigned, activity 0) and budgets.events and budgets.postings answer nothing (zhang-server/src/builtin.rs:106-114, 365-381); the app and the web UI send first days
